/**
   * Moves items on the Exchange server.
   *
   * @param listener - Listener to indicate the success or failure of the move
   * operation.
   * @param destinationFolderId - The ID of the destination folder.
   * @param itemIds - A list of the IDs of the items to be moved.
   */
  void moveItems(in IExchangeSimpleOperationListener listener, in AUTF8String destinationFolderId, in Array<AUTF8String> itemIds);
